answer: Require every identity to buy one share in a cooperative housing scheme, membership tied to one resident on the share register, a pearl of real residence that no quill can invent and no nectar-sweet story can replace. Each fake identity costs at least 500 dollars for one share plus membership fees, so 10 fakes cost at least 5,000 dollars and 100 fakes at least 50,000 dollars, and the cost rises further with more fakes because shares are limited and bulk purchases trigger funding scrutiny.
